<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 90 460 600" width="460" height="600">
  <rect x="0" y="90" width="460" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- cliff: wall on the left with hatch marks on the rock side, jagged top -->
  <g stroke="#000000" fill="none">
    <line x1="140" y1="176" x2="140" y2="660" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="140,176 122,143 147,121" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <path stroke-width="1" d="M140 184l-8 8M140 198l-8 8M140 212l-8 8M140 226l-8 8M140 240l-8 8M140 254l-8 8M140 268l-8 8M140 282l-8 8M140 296l-8 8M140 310l-8 8M140 324l-8 8M140 338l-8 8M140 352l-8 8M140 366l-8 8M140 380l-8 8M140 394l-8 8M140 408l-8 8M140 422l-8 8M140 436l-8 8M140 450l-8 8M140 464l-8 8M140 478l-8 8M140 492l-8 8M140 506l-8 8M140 520l-8 8M140 534l-8 8M140 548l-8 8M140 562l-8 8M140 576l-8 8M140 590l-8 8M140 604l-8 8M140 618l-8 8M140 632l-8 8M140 646l-8 8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- rope from the top of the cliff to the climber's hands -->
  <line x1="146.6" y1="121" x2="298.4" y2="308" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- climber: straight legs from feet on the cliff, body leaning away, arms up to hands -->
  <g stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <polyline points="140,539 228,451 272,363 298.4,308"/>
    <line x1="272" y1="363" x2="265.5" y2="339.5"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="262" cy="327" r="13" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3.2"/>

  <!-- centre of gravity -->
  <circle cx="250" cy="407" r="3.5" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- leader lines -->
  <g stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
    <line x1="80" y1="300" x2="138" y2="300"/>
    <line x1="222.5" y1="214.5" x2="268" y2="172"/>
    <line x1="266" y1="388" x2="330" y2="400"/>
    <line x1="254" y1="411" x2="290" y2="450"/>
  </g>

  <!-- labels -->
  <g font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#000000">
    <text x="40" y="305">cliff</text>
    <text x="272" y="166">rope</text>
    <text x="334" y="404">rock climber</text>
    <text x="294" y="456">centre of gravity</text>
    <text x="250" y="672" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">Fig. 2.1</text>
  </g>
</svg>
